gaps.sentence: He decided to go ___ for the chess championship.
gaps.explanation: 'Go in for' = take part in a competition.

gaps.sentence: She looks ___ on people who disagree with her.
gaps.explanation: look down on = consider inferior (opposite: look up to).

gaps.sentence: They've just moved ___ to their new flat.
gaps.explanation: move in = start living in a new home.

gaps.sentence: Feel free to drop ___ for a coffee any time.
gaps.explanation: drop in = pay a casual visit; drop off = fall asleep or deliver.

gaps.sentence: The players are gearing ___ for the final.
gaps.explanation: gear up for = prepare for a big event.

gaps.sentence: I stand ___ my decision — it was the right one.
gaps.explanation: stand by something = continue to support it; stand by somebody = help and support them.

gaps.sentence: Many consumers now opt ___ cheaper brands.
The bonus made up ___ all the overtime we had done.
gaps.explanation: make up FOR something = compensate for it.
